types.com-macro: A macro to send over the serial link.
types.com-utils: Helper utilities for accessing serial communications.

options.--init-commands <string>: The serial command to send to initialise the device.
options.--init-responses <string>: The expected response from the device after sending the init command, given as a regular expression.
options.--commands <string>: The sequence of commands to send in the macro, separated by semicolons.
options.--responses <string>: Expected responses for each command given as regular expressions, separated by semicolons.
options.--baud <string>: The baud rate for the serial connection.
options.--method <string>: The HTTP method to use (GET, POST, etc.) for a macro.
options.--startup-delay <number>: Optional delay in milliseconds to wait after opening the port before sending the init commands, to allow devices extra time to boot up.
